name: ritual
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: editorial photograph for a warm, refined German beauty salon website. Create one wide landscape photograph, aspect ratio 3:2, of a tranquil professional facial ritual: an adult woman lying on cream linen, soft ivory headband holding her hair back, eyes closed, real natural skin texture, a cosmetician's anatomically correct hands gently applying a thin ivory facial mask to her cheek with a small fan brush. Crop the cosmetician's identity out. Side angle, carefully composed, elegant editorial magazine photography, subtle film grain, gentle afternoon window light, warm ivory, muted olive and sand tones. Visible tactile linen, shallow depth of field. Authentic and quiet, not glamorous or airbrushed. No text, logos, before-and-after, exaggerated skin results or watermark. This is an illustrative scene, not a depiction of a named real person or clinic.
